rationale: Create one canonical ACL Airshop company and one active Astatine Investment Partners ownership period linked to Alinda Infrastructure Fund IV. Alinda-managed funds completed the acquisition in April 2021, and the January 2023 prospectus identifies ACL as an AF4 investment with a 100% AF4 equity interest. Alinda's April 2022 rename to Astatine was a manager rebrand rather than a sale. Astatine's live portfolio page marks ACL Active and its March 2026 release still calls ACL a portfolio company of Astatine-managed funds. No later sale, recapitalization, merger, sponsor change or signed pending ownership transaction was identified through August 17, 2026.

identityResolution.managerLevelBoundary: Count the global ACL Airshop ULD leasing and logistics platform once. Airport stations, ULD fleets, repair sites, software, products and customers are operations or assets, not separate PortCos.
identityResolution.duplicateDecision: No existing production or evaluated-seed company matches ACL Airshop. Historical names are aliases or predecessors, not separate current companies.

ownershipResolution.entryDate: April 2021; exact day not publicly disclosed
ownershipResolution.stake: 100% disclosed in January 2023; current percentage not subsequently restated

operatingResolution.subsector: Air cargo ULD leasing and logistics infrastructure
operatingResolution.disclosedScale: More than 100,000 ULDs owned, maintained or managed across 55 airport hubs, serving more than 200 airlines, air-cargo carriers and other transportation clients in March 2026.

acquisitionExitCheck.entry: ACL announced the closed Alinda acquisition on April 22, 2021 and said the transaction concluded in April 2021.
acquisitionExitCheck.currentStatus: Astatine lists ACL Active and reaffirmed current portfolio-company status in March 2026.
acquisitionExitCheck.subsequentExitSearch: No later sale, recapitalization, merger, sponsor change or signed pending ownership transaction was identified through 2026-08-17.

disclosureLimitations: The exact April 2021 legal closing day and purchase price are not publicly disclosed.
The specific acquisition holding vehicle is not publicly disclosed.
The 100% stake was directly disclosed in January 2023; current public sources reaffirm ownership but do not restate the percentage.
